hook_text: A tree as tall as a fifteen-storey building, and almost no sunlight on the ground. Who lives on each floor?
clip_script: A rainforest is like a tall building with four floors. On the dark forest floor, leaves rot fast and gorillas and okapi walk. In the understorey, young trees wait in the shade. In the thick canopy, monkeys, sloths and toucans live in a roof of leaves. Above it all, giant emergent trees poke into the sun, where eagles hunt. Every plant is racing towards the light.
visual_style: Whiteboard cross-section of a rainforest with four labelled layers, animals appearing on each layer, and arrows showing sunlight getting dimmer towards the ground.
mood: Lively and full of wonder, like a nature documentary.
pacing: Climb one layer at a time from the bottom up, pausing on each animal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw the four layers of the rainforest with one animal on each layer.
